measure: table rows: item count, item height, top index, header origin; item rect = row band (no item object is created)
tree rows: top-level count, item height, top item; item rect = row band
list rows: item count, item height, top index (Swing: cell bounds)
text lines: line count, line height, top line; item rect = line band
StyledText lines: line count, line height, top index
scroll bar units: maximum, thumb, selection; unit extent = viewport / thumb
drop-down rows: item count, row height, visible item count; item rect = row band in the drop-down
value positions: maximum - minimum + 1 positions, selection; item rect = the control surface
tab headers: item bounds along x
tool items: item bounds along x
child controls: child bounds; first and visible = children intersecting the client area
resolved per instance: SCROLL with a vertical bar, else CHILDREN with children, else SURFACE
one plane over a host control (menus, tool tips, dialogs, trays, providers, animators)
